steps.contract: Approve incident scope and restore point; freeze high-risk writes and new walk starts.
Prepare an identity-separated isolated host, empty PostGIS DB and nonexistent private upload root.
Verify trusted-signer manifest signature and every encrypted payload SHA-256.
Decrypt only in sealed memfd/tmpfs handling and precheck DB schema/version.
Restore the PostgreSQL custom dump with single-transaction semantics.
Restore objects into a staging tree and publish only after complete verification.
Reapply completed deletion ledger/tombstones and verify model/config signature and API compatibility.
Validate DB references, object bytes/hash, missing/orphan, rows/SRID and run synthetic restricted-read smoke.
Record actual RPO/RTO, loss and manual actions in a signed receipt; require separate approval before any traffic transition.
